newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S MADUGALLE TO REFEREE "ASHES" TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S MADUGALLE TO REFEREE "ASHES" TEST.

text.p: The International Cricket Council has appointed former Sri Lankan cricket captain Ranjan Madugalle as referee for the forthcoming test series between England and Australia, a newspaper said on Monday.

The state-owned Daily News said Madugalle, who retired from international cricket nine years ago, will be match referee for three of six test matches and the three one-day internationals to be played from May to early July when the Australians visit England.
